chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, similar to it.
And he said: There is no problem with the good scent between As-Safa and Al-Marwa from the scent of the perfumers, and he does not have to hold his nose.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to smell perfume while in Ihram during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the distinction between the prohibition of wearing perfume (applied to the body) and the permissibility of inhaling natural scents during the Sa'i ritual. It highlights the scholarly consensus that incidental exposure to fragrance, such as from perfumers' shops between Safa and Marwa, does not invalidate Ihram, provided one does not actively block the nose, thereby emphasizing ease in ritual practice.
